claims: The Vancouver Whitecaps defeated New York City FC 2-0.
The match took place on April 11, 2026.
The match took place at BC Place.
The win extended the Vancouver Whitecaps' best start in club MLS history to 6-1-0.
Mathías Laborda scored a goal in the 44th minute.
Brian White scored a goal in the 87th minute.
Yohei Takaoka earned his fourth clean sheet of the season.
Vancouver Whitecaps had 23 shots, 10 on target.
New York City FC had 12 shots, 2 on target.
NYCFC's Matt Freese made eight saves
